source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
This approach and timeline sound great, Nolan, so let’s move forward.

The first step should cover:
• system layout
• motor + component selection
• basic wiring plan

From there, the goal is to get a working prototype running as quickly as possible and refine it afterward. Tell me what information you need from me to begin.

value_updates.component_sourcing_strategy: use off-the-shelf components for the initial prototype where feasible

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Taking the recent design requirements into account, I’ve prepared the initial BOM for your review. Additional wires, hardware, and the custom-fabricated housing are not included yet, although I already have their materials in my shop; they will be added after the build begins. I’m now starting the initial cad design with rough component measurements. Once you approve and purchase the components, I can measure each physical piece accurately and fully refine the design. All components have been sourced from amazon so future changes or additions can be handled quickly.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports preparing an initial BOM from readily obtainable components while explicitly identifying wires, hardware, and custom-housing materials that remain to be added.
Freelancer presents the bill of materials as finalized.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: The updated BOM is ready. Compared with the previous version, the component changes are limited to replacing the PWM motor controllers with higher-power models and swapping the AC/DC adapter for an 80A version. That adapter should provide more than enough power, including reserve capacity to keep anything from overheating. I also rechecked all current pricing and corrected the discrepancies between several listed prices and the prices now available.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports completing a post-review BOM revision with higher-power PWM controllers and an 80A power supply.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Now that the BOM is approved, place the orders and I’ll reimburse you.

execution.observed_behavior: Client confirms that the BOM is approved and authorizes ordering from it.

routing_warnings.description: The freelancer's verification that the listed electrical and mechanical components are mutually compatible belongs to the separate component-interface compatibility Requirement.
The claim that the BOM and other records have been saved concerns retention of the documentation set rather than preparation of the BOM itself.
